verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Hookshot engage with your wall on cooldown; you win if you dig a grave, zone with E, and force her into trades she can't profitably start.

brief.thesis: Camille has no sustain tool besides W's cone heal and no way to reset neutral once her E (Hookshot) is down, so Yorick's W (Dark Procession) wall directly counters her only engage/escape tool by boxing her in or locking her out. Yorick's win condition is a slow siege: stack graves with Q (Last Rites), poke with E (Mourning Mist), and never let her Q (Precision Protocol) empowered auto land for free.

theirWindow.when: E is up and you're near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot off terrain to engage or disengage with a guaranteed knockup on landing. Back off from walls or pre-place your own W to block the hook's landing zone.

yourWindow.what: She has zero gap-close or escape. Walk up, land Q (Last Rites) for the heal, and use E (Mourning Mist) to shred her armor and slow — she cannot punish this window.

powerCurve.note: Neither has full combo; trade only on her Q cooldown
Camille gets E engage + Q burst online first
Grasp sustain and W walls outscale her all-in
Trinity Force spike lets you win extended trades
Her ult picks you if caught alone in side lane

start.why: Blocks the harass from her empowered Q auto and W cone poke so you aren't zoned off minions before level 6.

boots.why: She's entirely physical damage from autos and Q/W/R procs; the flat reduction on repeated hits outvalues Mercury's here.

core.why: The spellblade proc turns your Q-empowered auto into real burst and lets you actually win a trade once she's committed her E.
Cooldown reduction lets you throw E (Mourning Mist) and dig graves with Q more often, which is your whole win condition against her lack of sustain.
Shreds her armor further on top of your E's reduction, making your autos and Trinity proc hit much harder through her passive shield.

situational.when: she is landing her full Q-into-E all-in on you repeatedly
she builds armor or you need the slow to stop her kiting after Hookshot
lane is won and you want to push waves and split since she has no wave-clear answer to Mist Walkers

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the slow grinding trades this matchup wants — proc Grasp on her every time she walks up post-E, and the max-health damage plus heal wins attrition she can't match without sustain.

summoners.why: Teleport is the most-picked combo (52% pick rate) because Yorick wants to use his wave-shoving graves to roam or reset after she commits Hookshot; Flash is your only answer to her E engage range (800).

playing.title: Hold E for her Q window
playing.detail: Throw Mourning Mist the moment she commits her empowered Q auto (after the delay for bonus damage) — she can't dodge it mid-animation and you get the slow to punish the recast window.

playing.title: Wall her hook landing spot
playing.detail: W (Dark Procession) placed on the terrain she's about to Hookshot off of blocks the dash entirely, per OP.GG's own read on this lane — bait the E, then box her in.

playing.title: Don't rush all-ins blind
playing.detail: You have the solo-kill edge in this matchup, but only after you've wasted her E — rushing while Hookshot is up just hands her the knockup and the trade.

playing.title: Dig graves every Q cycle
playing.detail: Last Rites is up every 6-4s depending on rank; land it on minions or her to keep grave count high so your Mist Walkers are swarming by mid-lane.

playing.title: Track her ult at 11
playing.detail: The Hextech Ultimatum (140-90s cooldown, 475 range) anchors you in place from level 6 but only unlocks real pressure once she has Trinity-equivalent damage around 11 — respect roams after that point.

playing.title: Freeze if you're already ahead
playing.detail: Since Yorick has lane and solo-kill advantage here, freezing near your tower after level 6 denies her the E-engage space she needs off jungle walls or river bushes.

brief.patchCaveat: Build order, rune pages, and the 49.5% head-to-head win rate over 689 games are measured from live OP.GG data on patch 16.19.1; the ability readings, timing windows, and trade logic are my own analysis of the kit interactions.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with Camille’s (E). Trap her inside [W] if she closes in with (E). Try not to make a mistake by rushing as you can easily kill her.
